description: Integration verification: run full backend + frontend typecheck and build after all previous FEATs complete, record results. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001, FEAT-002, FEAT-003 (code fixes). It does NOT start Docker or run the database — it only verifies TypeScript compilation and frontend build, which are the automated verification criteria required by the task. Record all results in the FEAT findings field.
steps: Install backend dependencies if node_modules is missing: cd backend && npm install
Install frontend dependencies if node_modules is missing: cd frontend && npm install
Run backend typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit — capture output, confirm 0 errors
Run frontend typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck — capture output, confirm 0 errors
Run frontend production build: cd frontend && npm run build — capture output, confirm build succeeds
Record all command outputs and exit codes in this FEAT's findings field
If any command fails: read the error, identify the file and line, fix the TypeScript error (do not introduce new logic — only fix type compatibility), re-run the failing command
After all three commands pass: set FEAT status to completed and record final results in findings
acceptance_criteria: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
cd frontend && npm run typecheck exits with code 0
cd frontend && npm run build exits with code 0
frontend/dist/ directory exists and contains index.html and assets/
